evidence: The NbN ALD process is based on a self-limiting surface reaction principle with a well-controlled layer growth of 0.46 Å per cycle. Thus, for the CQUID experiments, superconducting NbN layers of only 3.3 nm thickness were prepared within an ALD process of 72 cycles. The metal–organic compound (tertbutylimido)-tris (diethylamino)-niobium (TBTDEN) and an hydrogen plasma were applied as precursors.
